topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't stop pacing, my phone clutched in my hand, like if I move fast enough, I might shake off this news. It feels like all the air was sucked out of the room when they told me. How could they just decide to move so far away? It's not like they talked to me about it, didn't consider the impact on us. We've been through everything together, and now this? I'm not sure how to face this, how to handle the thought of weeks, months, maybe even years without them here. I need to find a way to make them reconsider, to show them why staying is the only option. What will I do without them?
